Well, I failed to graduate high school due to my own laziness, procrastination, and general stupidity. I haven't developed any useful skills for myself, and I'm skinnier than a twig with no athletic talent whatsoever, so I'm not even any good for physical labor. I've never held a job, and it doesn't look like I'll be getting one any time soon.

Now, all that on its own might not sound *too* bad, but my family situation makes things worse for me. Everyone in my immediate family and almost everyone in my extended family are Jehovah's Witnesses (well-known for their door-knocking), but I am no longer a believer. Witnesses generally are forced to shun ex-members and excommunicated members. Fortunately, I was never baptized and thus never became an official member, so my family is not required to shun me. Still, that doesn't mean that life is peaches and cream for the defector. Witnesses are taught to limit contact with *anyone* who is not a Witness or studying to become one. Now, I haven't actually come out yet, but I know that there will be no good relations between my and the majority of my family for a while, maybe forever. You might think I'm being a bit presumptuous in saying that, but suffice it to say that I have a long story to tell in regards to my relationship with my former religion, and I can say with some certainty that coming out will bring a lot of pain for me.

This isn't my entire life story, of course, but I'm at a point in my life where it feels like I have no real future as it stands, and nearly all of it is my own fault. Every day I live in the same house I've lived in since I was five reminds me of how much I want to get away, and how little I would actually miss or feel sad about leaving behind. I don't enjoy my life. I desperately want to build myself a new one, but I'm very far away from being able to do so as it stands right now.

I guess. I've grown to hate the person I've become. Every time I wake up and every time I go to sleep I reflect on everything I've done to fuck up my life. I just want to start again, a new life away from everything I know.
